title: Chupke Chupke
desc: Mischievous botany professor Parimal Tripathi plays a little trick on his brother-in-law Raghav. Jealous of the high esteem in which his own wife holds the other man, Parimal decides to impersonate Raghav's new driver.

title: Bawarchi
desc: Shivnath is the head of the Sharma family, who are so argumentative that they have succeeded in scaring away every cook they've ever employed. So when young chef Raghu shows up, nobody expects him to last long.

title: Do Waqt Ki Roti
desc: When a notorious criminal breaks out of prison, Jailer Vijay resigns and vows to arrest him. However, Shankar, a brother set on avenging his sister's death, stands in Vijay's way.

title: Gunda Gardi
desc: A righteous police commissioner, Karan Singh, tries to nab the notorious mafia duo, Narasimha and Kalicharan. After his brother-in-law gets murdered, he plans to take help from the eye-witness, Deepa, to get hold of the criminals.
